# SpectralEstimationStreaming

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for estimating frequency components of a continuous, non-stationary signal in real-time using spiking neural dynamics rather than batch FFT processing. This shifts spectral analysis from energy-intensive digital processing to event-driven neuromorphic computation, key for iNEST's in-network radar signal interpretation.
